message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crimes based on facts. The facts: a police officer (state staff) accepted bribes (507,100 yuan) for protecting a hotel involved in prostitution, and also abused his power by giving advance warning (通风报信) to help the hotel evade anti-prostitution raids. So crimes: "受贿" (accepting bribes) and "滥用职权" (abuse of power). Possibly also "为他人谋取利益罪"? But typical Chinese criminal law: State staff accepting bribes = 受贿罪 (Article 385). Abuse of power = 滥用职权罪 (Article 397?). The prompt examples: For similar case (姜1某) they gave answer "受贿;滥用职权". So we should output those two charges.

Thus final answer: [罪名]受贿;滥用职权<eoa>
